traits.name: Aura of Doom
traits.text: (aura, death, divine); 60 feet. Any creature that begins its turn in the aura is doomed 1 for as long as it remains in the aura and for 1 hour thereafter.

traits.name: Apocalypse Breath
traits.text: ⬺ to ⬽ (divine, negative); The daemon expels a shrieking black cloud of smoke from its mouth in a 120-foot line or a 60-foot cone (or both a line and a cone in the same direction if it spends 3 actions). Living creatures in the area take 24d6 (24d6) negative damage (DC 45 basic Reflex save) The olethrodaemon can't use Apocalypse Breath again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Soul Crush
traits.text: ⬺ (manipulate); Requirements The olethrodaemon has a soul gem Effect The olethrodaemon crushes the soul gem in one hand and regains the use of Apocalypse Breath or any one of its innate spells.

traits.name: Swallow Whole
traits.text: ⬻ (attack); Huge, 4d10+10 (4d10+10) bludgeoning and drained 2, Rupture 43. An olethrodaemon has numerous stomachs connected by labyrinthine digestive organs. Swallowed creatures cannot Escape, but can attempt to cut their way out with a 1d6 (1d6) roll. On a roll of 1–3, the creature cuts into yet another stomach. On a roll of 4–6, the creature manages to cut its way out of the olethrodaemon.
